    Base surfacebody: shape torus; radius 0.95; tube 0.42sphere · torus · cylinder · plane · wave

    Mapped glyph layercode: glyphs; on body; pattern grid; flicker 8grid · band · scatter · curve. Multiple layers can share a surface.

    Surface text / pathslabel: glyphs; on body; pattern band;
    text "SIGNAL / "; flow 1    Use uv [[0,0.2],[0.3,0.8],[0.7,0.2],[1,0.8]]for a cubic curve mapped onto the surface. U and V run from 0 to 1.

    Independent movementbody: shape cylinder; rotate y 1Rotate the host surface. Flow slides a band or its text along a mapped curve. Flicker changes glyphs at fixed positions.

    Free 3D pathspath: bezier; points [[-1,-1,0],
    [-2,1,1],[2,-1,-1],[1,1,0]]; rainbow; flow 1    A free ribbon does not need a host.

    Character behaviorhold · flicker 8 · stream 6Stream adds falling trails to screen-space rain.

    Surfaces

    Glyph layers

    HOST SURFACE

    Changing this shape remaps every attached glyph layer.

    Mapped glyphs stay on this surface. Rotate the host; use flow for the band or curve.

    Surface → pattern → glyph behavior. Several layers can share one shape; free ribbons and rain remain independent.
